name: FileSpec
description:
FileSpec is a File's name and type. Both are set by the upload and never
 change: a File's bytes are immutable, and so is what describes them.

fields.name: Filename
fields.description:
The file's name, as the uploader named it: "q3-ledger.xlsx".

 At most 255 characters, with no `/`, `\` or control characters, and not
 `.` or `..`.

fields.name: MimeType
fields.description:
The media type: "image/png", "application/pdf". The upload's own, else
 the filename's extension, else "application/octet-stream".
